{{Top|leg}}
The '''Grandine Swoop Loop''' was one of the many [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop racing]] courses during the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] leading up to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Tobb Jadak]] once held the speed record at the Grandine Swoop Loop, pushing his [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] to a speed of 655 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] per hour.
